description: Schema definition for Product Items that stores comprehensive product information and inventory details

id.desc: Unique identifier for the product item

company.desc: The company name associated with the product item; references the Companies schema's name field

displayName.desc: Primary display name for the product item

displayName2.desc: Secondary display name for the product item (if applicable)

type.desc: Type or classification of the product item

itemCategoryId.desc: Identifier for the product item's category; references the Product Items Category schema's id field

itemCategoryCode.desc: Code for the product item's category; references the Product Items Category schema's code field

blocked.desc: Flag indicating whether the product item is blocked or inactive

gtin.desc: Global Trade Item Number (GTIN) for the product item

inventory.desc: Available inventory quantity for the product item

unitPrice.desc: Unit price of the product item

priceIncludesTax.desc: Indicates whether the unit price includes tax

unitCost.desc: Cost per unit for the product item

taxGroupId.desc: Identifier for the tax group applicable to the product item

taxGroupCode.desc: Code for the tax group of the product item

baseUnitOfMeasureId.desc: Identifier for the base unit of measure used for the product item

baseUnitOfMeasureCode.desc: Code representing the base unit of measure for the product item

generalProductPostingGroupId.desc: Identifier for the general product posting group

generalProductPostingGroupCode.desc: Code for the general product posting group

inventoryPostingGroupId.desc: Identifier for the inventory posting group

inventoryPostingGroupCode.desc: Code for the inventory posting group

lastModifiedDateTime.desc: Timestamp indicating when the product item was last modified
